decisions.reason: A net price display plugin costs little to keep in a plugin store and its demand is still uncertain after one year, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost.
The ERP interface plugin builds on the firm's core offer and supports multichannel integration, which gives it strategic option value at a low maintenance cost.
This price comparison tracking plugin overlaps with two sibling plugins, but listing it costs little and the value of price-portal integrations has not yet resolved.
This is one of three similar price comparison plugins, which raises the chance of consolidation, but low carrying cost and unresolved uncertainty still favor keeping it.
This third overlapping price comparison plugin is the most likely to be merged or dropped, yet the evidence does not show that its value has failed to materialize.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A at a low maintenance cost, and its uncertain demand justifies holding the option.
